Hey Robin! ;D

SNOWBLO_ODY will be punished for his actions, as he was in combat with another player. It appears while he was in combat, that he locked onto his target, and he shifted his head towards his team mate while they were both in combat. As it appeared he has Aimbot.

As for Samuellinger, he wasn't in combat. So, I'll leave Sam up to another Mod to decide what action should be taken with him.

So, Reviewing for Sam ^.^

Thanks for the reports! ;D
